details.label: Summary
details.text: Thunderstorms are expected to increase in coverage and intensity through the afternoon into the early evening hours across portions of southern Ohio and adjacent areas of Kentucky and West Virginia. The strongest storms may pose a damaging wind threat, however, the overall severe weather threat is expected to remain too isolated to warrant a watch

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Convection associated with a remnant MCV moving eastward across the Ohio Valley is intensifying as it moves into a modestly unstable airmass. Additionally, storms are developing along an east-west oriented cold front in southern Ohio. Although lapse rates are modest and limiting the updraft potential, deep-layer shear is sufficient to assist with storm organization and longevity. The storms will move east-southeastward through the afternoon and evening posing an isolated risk of damaging winds, especially for storms that cluster and grow upscale. The severe wind threat is expected to remain too marginal/isolated to warrant a watch, but convective trends will be monitored
